note: Answers collected since June 2025 to one question: how would you feel if AI produced a Lean-verified proof of the Riemann hypothesis that humans could not understand? Speakers include Kevin Buzzard, Terence Tao, Jordan Ellenberg, Ken Ono, Daniel Litt, Leo de Moura and Alex Kontorovich; released the day after Alpöge's announcement made the question real.
title: Since last year, we asked: “What if AI solved the Riemann Hypothesis?”
